content.short: Clearpool is a decentralized institutional credit marketplace where users lend stablecoins to permissioned institutional borrowers for market-leading yields.
content.description: Clearpool is a decentralized institutional credit protocol allowing DeFi users to lend stablecoins to vetted institutional borrowers such as market makers and trading firms through single-borrower, uncollateralized lending pools. Borrowers create pools and set their own competitive interest rates, creating a transparent on-chain credit market. Clearpool is deployed on Mantle and provides DeFi lenders access to institutional-grade credit yields that are typically unavailable in traditional overcollateralized lending protocols.
content.meta: Clearpool is a decentralized credit marketplace for lending to institutions with attractive yields on Mantle. Discover Clearpool on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
